description: This file defines the UserGroup class within the OpenCart admin module, handling CRUD operations and permission management for user groups in the system.

classes.name: UserGroup
classes.description: A class managing user group records in the database, including creation, modification, deletion, retrieval, and permission management within the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: addUserGroup
methods.description: Creates a new user group record in the database with specified data, including name and permissions.

methods.name: editUserGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing user group's name and permissions based on the provided user group ID.

methods.name: deleteUserGroup
methods.description: Deletes a user group record from the database identified by the user group ID.

methods.name: getUserGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a user group's details, including permissions, for the given user group ID.

methods.name: getUserGroups
methods.description: Fetches multiple user group records, with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalUserGroups
methods.description: Returns the total number of user group records in the database.

methods.name: addPermission
methods.description: Adds a specific permission route to a user group's permission set.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a specific permission route from a user group's permission set.
